direct_fault: TroopDesigner.SubModule.EnableSearch() throws System.NullReferenceException from OnApplicationTick(Single) in both dumps
cause: TroopDesigner reads GauntletInventoryScreen._dataSource and dereferences IsSearchAvailable without a null check. Game v1.4.8 constructs _dataSource in OnReady rather than OnInitialize, so the screen may already be topmost while its view model is still null.
